newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet spreads stable in scattered trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet spreads stable in scattered trade.

text.p: European jet fuel traded on Tuesday at around unchanged differentials in scattered volume, with some tightness seen on barges.
August IPE gas oil futures closed 50 cents firmer at $163 a tonne, helped higher by buoyant NYMEX crude.
Barges moved at around August IPE +$17/$17.50 in private and confidential deals with buyers chasing meagre supply.

A 25,000-30,000 tonne cargo of Sonatrach Algerian material moved at close to $10 over Med high quotes but details of that trade and others in Northwest Europe were not immediately available. Italian material remained notionally at $7 over quotes high.
